esbuild is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2026 to 2026.

What it was for: [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [Oscilla](@/work/oscilla.md): Generate, measure and reproduce sound experiments, and know how far each result can be trusted. Every readout carries its uncertainty; [vomaste.cz](@/work/vomaste-cz.md).

2 of these projects run as live sites.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses esbuild: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links esbuild to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
